entities.name: EXO84
observations: Exact 679-residue sequence match to reviewed Gibberella zeae Exocyst complex component EXO84 (UniProt Q4HYZ2).
Predicted molecular mass is 76.46 kDa, theoretical pI 9.54, and net charge at pH 7 is +21.24.

Sequence contains disordered/low-complexity N-terminal regions, a predicted coiled-coil region around residues 129–213, and Pfam domains VPS51_Exo84_N (129–213), PH_EXO84 (238–412), and Exo84_C (455–654).
No explicit catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved; this supports a nonenzymatic structural/scaffolding role but does not formally prove absence of enzymatic activity.

entities.name: Exocyst complex
observations: EXO84 is a component of the exocyst complex, which tethers secretory vesicles at sites of exocytosis and contributes to complex assembly and polarization at the plasma membrane.

Associated Gene Ontology terms include exocyst (GO:0000145), transport vesicle (GO:0030133), exocytosis (GO:0006887), Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport (GO:0006893), and intracellular protein localization (GO:0008104).

entities.name: Secretory vesicle
observations: EXO84 localization is annotated to cytoplasmic/secretory vesicles and the cell periphery; polarization depends on actin cables in fungal reference annotations.
